   265	class GpuCandidateEngine {
   266	public:
   267	    GpuCandidateEngine(const std::vector<double>& point_x,
   268	                       const std::vector<double>& point_y,
   269	                       int maximum_seed_count,
   270	                       int ranks_sharing_gpu)
   271	        : point_count_(static_cast<int>(point_x.size())) {
   272	        const std::size_t point_bytes =
   273	            static_cast<std::size_t>(point_count_) * sizeof(double);
   274	        const std::size_t member_bytes =
   275	            static_cast<std::size_t>(point_count_) * sizeof(int);
   276	
   277	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&device_x_, point_bytes));
   278	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&device_y_, point_bytes));
   279	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&device_clustered_,
   280	                              static_cast<std::size_t>(point_count_)));
   281	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&device_members_, member_bytes));
   282	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_x_, point_x.data(), point_bytes,
   283	                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
   284	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_y_, point_y.data(), point_bytes,
   285	                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
   286	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(device_clustered_, 0,
   287	                              static_cast<std::size_t>(point_count_)));
   288	
   289	        std::size_t free_bytes = 0;
   290	        std::size_t total_bytes = 0;
   291	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemGetInfo(&free_bytes, &total_bytes));
   292	        (void)total_bytes;
   293	
   294	        const std::size_t row_bytes =
   295	            static_cast<std::size_t>(point_count_) * sizeof(double);
   296	        // Leave room for the CUDA context, MPI buffers, and concurrent ranks
   297	        // in case users intentionally place more than one rank on a GPU.
   298	        const std::size_t usable_bytes =
   299	            (free_bytes / 5U * 4U) /
   300	            static_cast<std::size_t>(std::max(1, ranks_sharing_gpu));
   301	        const int requested_capacity = std::max(1, maximum_seed_count);
   302	        const std::size_t memory_capacity =
   303	            std::max<std::size_t>(1, usable_bytes / row_bytes);
   304	        batch_capacity_ = static_cast<int>(std::min<std::size_t>(
   305	            static_cast<std::size_t>(requested_capacity), memory_capacity));
   306	
   307	        // Fragmented or concurrently allocated device memory can make the
   308	        // estimate optimistic.  Retrying smaller batches keeps memory usage
   309	        // bounded without changing the algorithm.
   310	        while (batch_capacity_ > 0) {
   311	            const std::size_t workspace_bytes =
   312	                static_cast<std::size_t>(batch_capacity_) * row_bytes;
   313	            const cudaError_t status =
   314	                cudaMalloc(&device_max_distances_, workspace_bytes);
   315	            if (status == cudaSuccess) {
   316	                break;
   317	            }
   318	            cudaGetLastError();
   319	            batch_capacity_ /= 2;
   320	        }
   321	        if (batch_capacity_ == 0) {
   322	            CUDA_CHECK(cudaErrorMemoryAllocation);
   323	        }
   324	
   325	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&device_seeds_,
   326	                              static_cast<std::size_t>(batch_capacity_) *
   327	                                  sizeof(int)));
   328	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&device_cardinalities_,
   329	                              static_cast<std::size_t>(batch_capacity_) *
   330	                                  sizeof(int)));
   331	        host_cardinalities_.resize(batch_capacity_);
   332	    }
   333	
   334	    GpuCandidateEngine(const GpuCandidateEngine&) = delete;
   335	    GpuCandidateEngine& operator=(const GpuCandidateEngine&) = delete;
   336	
   337	    ~GpuCandidateEngine() {
   338	        cudaFree(device_cardinalities_);
   339	        cudaFree(device_seeds_);
   340	        cudaFree(device_max_distances_);
   341	        cudaFree(device_members_);
   342	        cudaFree(device_clustered_);
   343	        cudaFree(device_y_);
   344	        cudaFree(device_x_);
   345	    }
   346	
   347	    int batchCapacity() const { return batch_capacity_; }
   348	
   349	    std::pair<int, int> evaluate(const std::vector<int>& seeds,
   350	                                 double threshold_squared) {
   351	        int best_cardinality = -1;
   352	        int best_seed = INT_MAX;
   353	
   354	        for (std::size_t offset = 0; offset < seeds.size();
   355	             offset += static_cast<std::size_t>(batch_capacity_)) {
   356	            const int batch_size = static_cast<int>(std::min<std::size_t>(
   357	                static_cast<std::size_t>(batch_capacity_),
   358	                seeds.size() - offset));
   359	            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_seeds_, seeds.data() + offset,
   360	                                  static_cast<std::size_t>(batch_size) * sizeof(int),
   361	                                  cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
   362	
   363	            growCandidatesKernel<false>
   364	                <<<batch_size, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
   365	                    device_x_, device_y_, device_clustered_, device_seeds_,
   366	                    device_cardinalities_, nullptr, device_max_distances_,
   367	                    point_count_, threshold_squared);
   368	            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
   369	            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(host_cardinalities_.data(),
   370	                                  device_cardinalities_,
   371	                                  static_cast<std::size_t>(batch_size) * sizeof(int),
   372	                                  cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
   373	
   374	            for (int index = 0; index < batch_size; ++index) {
   375	                const int seed = seeds[offset + static_cast<std::size_t>(index)];
   376	                const int cardinality = host_cardinalities_[index];
   377	                if (cardinality > best_cardinality ||
   378	                    (cardinality == best_cardinality && seed < best_seed)) {
   379	                    best_cardinality = cardinality;
   380	                    best_seed = seed;
   381	                }
   382	            }
   383	        }
   384	
   385	        return {best_cardinality, best_seed};
   386	    }
   387	
   388	    std::vector<int> materialize(int seed, int expected_cardinality,
   389	                                 double threshold_squared) {
   390	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_seeds_, &seed, sizeof(int),
   391	                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
   392	        growCandidatesKernel<true><<<1, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
   393	            device_x_, device_y_, device_clustered_, device_seeds_,
   394	            device_cardinalities_, device_members_, device_max_distances_,
   395	            point_count_, threshold_squared);
   396	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
   397	
   398	        int cardinality = 0;
   399	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(&cardinality, device_cardinalities_, sizeof(int),
   400	                              cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
   401	        if (cardinality != expected_cardinality) {
   402	            int rank = -1;
   403	            MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);
   404	            std::fprintf(stderr,
   405	                         "MPI rank %d: regenerated seed %d with size %d, "
   406	                         "expected %d\n",
   407	                         rank, seed, cardinality, expected_cardinality);
   408	            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
   409	        }
   410	
   411	        std::vector<int> members(static_cast<std::size_t>(cardinality));
   412	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(members.data(), device_members_,
   413	                              static_cast<std::size_t>(cardinality) * sizeof(int),
   414	                              cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
   415	        return members;
   416	    }
   417	
   418	    void markClustered(const std::vector<int>& members) {
   419	        const int member_count = static_cast<int>(members.size());
   420	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_members_, members.data(),
   421	                              static_cast<std::size_t>(member_count) * sizeof(int),
   422	                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
   423	        const int block_count =
   424	            (member_count + CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE - 1) / CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE;
   425	        markClusteredKernel<<<block_count, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
   426	            device_clustered_, device_members_, member_count);
   427	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
   428	    }
   429	
   430	private:
   431	    int point_count_ = 0;
   432	    int batch_capacity_ = 0;
   433	    double* device_x_ = nullptr;
   434	    double* device_y_ = nullptr;
   435	    double* device_max_distances_ = nullptr;
   436	    unsigned char* device_clustered_ = nullptr;
   437	    int* device_seeds_ = nullptr;
   438	    int* device_cardinalities_ = nullptr;
   439	    int* device_members_ = nullptr;
   440	    std::vector<int> host_cardinalities_;
   441	};
   442	
   443	std::vector<Cluster> qtClusteringHybrid(const std::vector<Point>& points,
   444	                                        double threshold,
   445	                                        GpuCandidateEngine& gpu,
   446	                                        int rank, int world_size) {
   447	    const int point_count = static_cast<int>(points.size());
   448	    const double threshold_squared = threshold * threshold;
   449	    std::vector<unsigned char> clustered(static_cast<std::size_t>(point_count), 0);
   450	    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;
   451	    std::vector<int> local_seeds;
   452	    local_seeds.reserve(
   453	        static_cast<std::size_t>((point_count + world_size - 1) / world_size));
   454	    int remaining = point_count;
   455	
   456	    while (remaining > 0) {
   457	        local_seeds.clear();
   458	        for (int seed = rank; seed < point_count; seed += world_size) {
   459	            if (!clustered[seed]) {
   460	                local_seeds.push_back(seed);
   461	            }
   462	        }
   463	
   464	        const auto [local_cardinality, local_seed] =
   465	            gpu.evaluate(local_seeds, threshold_squared);
   466	
   467	        struct {
   468	            int cardinality;
   469	            int seed;
   470	        } local_best{local_cardinality, local_seed}, global_best{-1, INT_MAX};
   471	
   472	        MPI_Allreduce(&local_best, &global_best, 1, MPI_2INT,
   473	                      MPI_MAXLOC, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
   474	        if (global_best.seed == INT_MAX || global_best.cardinality <= 0) {
   475	            break;
   476	        }
   477	
   478	        // If the largest candidate is a singleton, every remaining candidate
   479	        // is a singleton.  Removing points cannot make a later candidate grow,
   480	        // so emit the rest in the original ascending-seed order without one
   481	        // global synchronization per point.
   482	        if (global_best.cardinality == 1) {
   483	            if (rank == 0) {
   484	                for (int seed = 0; seed < point_count; ++seed) {
   485	                    if (!clustered[seed]) {
   486	                        clusters.push_back(Cluster{{seed}, seed});
   487	                    }
   488	                }
   489	            }
   490	            remaining = 0;
   491	            break;
   492	        }
   493	
   494	        const int owner = global_best.seed % world_size;
   495	        std::vector<int> best_members;
   496	        if (rank == owner) {
   497	            best_members = gpu.materialize(global_best.seed,
   498	                                           global_best.cardinality,
   499	                                           threshold_squared);
   500	        } else {
   501	            best_members.resize(
   502	                static_cast<std::size_t>(global_best.cardinality));
   503	        }
   504	        MPI_Bcast(best_members.data(), global_best.cardinality, MPI_INT,
   505	                  owner, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
   506	
   507	#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
   508	        for (int index = 0; index < global_best.cardinality; ++index) {
   509	            clustered[best_members[static_cast<std::size_t>(index)]] = 1;
   510	        }
   511	        gpu.markClustered(best_members);
   512	        remaining -= global_best.cardinality;
   513	
   514	        if (rank == 0) {
   515	            clusters.push_back(Cluster{std::move(best_members), global_best.seed});
   516	        }
   517	    }
   518	
   519	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());
   520	    return clusters;
   521	}
   522	
   523	bool validateClusters(const std::vector<Cluster>& clusters,
   524	                      const std::vector<Point>& points,
   525	                      double threshold) {
   526	    bool valid = true;
   527	    std::printf("Validating clusters:\n");
   528	
   529	    std::vector<double> diameters(clusters.size(), 0.0);
   530	#pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic, 1)
   531	    for (std::ptrdiff_t cluster_index = 0;
   532	         cluster_index < static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(clusters.size());
   533	         ++cluster_index) {
   534	        const Cluster& cluster = clusters[static_cast<std::size_t>(cluster_index)];
   535	        double max_diameter = 0.0;
   536	        for (std::size_t first = 0; first < cluster.members.size(); ++first) {
   537	            for (std::size_t second = first + 1;
   538	                 second < cluster.members.size(); ++second) {
   539	                const double distance = pointDistance(
   540	                    points[cluster.members[first]], points[cluster.members[second]]);
   541	                max_diameter = std::max(max_diameter, distance);
   542	            }
   543	        }
   544	        diameters[static_cast<std::size_t>(cluster_index)] = max_diameter;
   545	    }
   546	
   547	    for (std::size_t cluster_index = 0;
   548	         cluster_index < clusters.size(); ++cluster_index) {
   549	        const Cluster& cluster = clusters[cluster_index];
   550	        const double max_diameter = diameters[cluster_index];
   551	        if (cluster_index < 10) {
   552	            std::printf("  Cluster %zu: size=%zu, seed=%d, diameter=%.4f\n",
   553	                        cluster_index, cluster.members.size(),
   554	                        cluster.seed_point, max_diameter);
   555	        }
   556	        if (max_diameter > threshold * 1.001) {
   557	            std::printf("ERROR: Cluster %zu has diameter %.4f > threshold %.4f\n",
   558	                        cluster_index, max_diameter, threshold);
   559	            valid = false;
   560	        }
   561	    }
   562	
   563	    std::vector<int> membership(points.size(), -1);
   564	    for (std::size_t cluster_index = 0;
   565	         cluster_index < clusters.size(); ++cluster_index) {
   566	        for (const int member : clusters[cluster_index].members) {
   567	            if (membership[member] >= 0) {
   568	                std::printf(
   569	                    "ERROR: Point %d appears in multiple clusters (%d and %zu)\n",
   570	                    member, membership[member], cluster_index);
   571	                valid = false;
   572	            }
   573	            membership[member] = static_cast<int>(cluster_index);
   574	        }
   575	    }
   576	
   577	    int clustered_count = 0;
   578	#pragma omp parallel for reduction(+ : clustered_count) schedule(static)
   579	    for (std::ptrdiff_t index = 0;
   580	         index < static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(membership.size()); ++index) {
   581	        clustered_count += membership[static_cast<std::size_t>(index)] >= 0;
   582	    }
   583	
   584	    std::printf("Total points: %zu, Clustered: %d, Unclustered: %zu\n",
   585	                points.size(), clustered_count,
   586	                points.size() - static_cast<std::size_t>(clustered_count));
   587	    return valid;
   588	}

+__device__ __forceinline__ void warpReduceBest(double& distance, int& index) {

+// Grow one candidate per CUDA block.  Storing only the running maximum
+// squared distance for every point turns the original repeated O(k) diameter
+// scan into one O(N) update per added member.  Squaring is monotone for these
+// non-negative distances, so choices and the strict threshold are unchanged.
+template <bool SAVE_MEMBERS>
+__global__ void growCandidatesKernel(const double* __restrict__ point_x,
+                                     const double* __restrict__ point_y,
+                                     const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,
+                                     const int* __restrict__ seeds,
+                                     int* __restrict__ cardinalities,
+                                     int* __restrict__ saved_members,
+                                     double* __restrict__ max_distance_squared,
+                                     int point_count,
+                                     double threshold_squared) {
+    const int row = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x);
+    const int seed = seeds[row];
+    double* const distances = max_distance_squared +
+                              static_cast<std::size_t>(row) * point_count;
+
+    constexpr int warp_count = CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32;
+    __shared__ double warp_distance[warp_count];
+    __shared__ int warp_index[warp_count];
+    __shared__ int selected;
+    __shared__ int cardinality;
+
+    for (int point = threadIdx.x; point < point_count; point += blockDim.x) {
+        if (clustered[point] || point == seed) {
+            distances[point] = DBL_MAX;
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        const double dx = point_x[point] - point_x[seed];
+        const double dy = point_y[point] - point_y[seed];
+        const double distance_squared = dx * dx + dy * dy;
+        // A rejected point can never become eligible: its running maximum
+        // only increases as the candidate cluster grows.
+        distances[point] = distance_squared < threshold_squared
+                               ? distance_squared
+                               : DBL_MAX;
+    }
+
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
+        cardinality = 1;
+        if constexpr (SAVE_MEMBERS) {
+            saved_members[0] = seed;
         }
     }
-    
-    return closest_point;
-}
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    while (true) {
+        double local_distance = DBL_MAX;
+        int local_index = INT_MAX;
+
+        for (int point = threadIdx.x; point < point_count; point += blockDim.x) {
+            const double distance_squared = distances[point];
+            if (distance_squared < threshold_squared &&
+                betterCandidate(distance_squared, point,
+                                local_distance, local_index)) {
+                local_distance = distance_squared;
+                local_index = point;
+            }
+        }
+
+        warpReduceBest(local_distance, local_index);
+        const int lane = threadIdx.x & (warpSize - 1);
+        const int warp = threadIdx.x / warpSize;
+        if (lane == 0) {
+            warp_distance[warp] = local_distance;
+            warp_index[warp] = local_index;
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        if (warp == 0) {
+            local_distance = lane < warp_count ? warp_distance[lane] : DBL_MAX;
+            local_index = lane < warp_count ? warp_index[lane] : INT_MAX;
+            warpReduceBest(local_distance, local_index);
+            if (lane == 0) {
+                selected = local_index == INT_MAX ? -1 : local_index;
+                if (selected >= 0) {
+                    if constexpr (SAVE_MEMBERS) {
+                        saved_members[cardinality] = selected;
+                    }
+                    ++cardinality;
+                }
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();

+class GpuCandidateEngine {
+public:
+    GpuCandidateEngine(const std::vector<double>& point_x,
+                       const std::vector<double>& point_y,
+                       int maximum_seed_count,
+                       int ranks_sharing_gpu)
+        : point_count_(static_cast<int>(point_x.size())) {
+        const std::size_t point_bytes =
+            static_cast<std::size_t>(point_count_) * sizeof(double);
+        const std::size_t member_bytes =
+            static_cast<std::size_t>(point_count_) * sizeof(int);
+
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&device_x_, point_bytes));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&device_y_, point_bytes));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&device_clustered_,
+                              static_cast<std::size_t>(point_count_)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&device_members_, member_bytes));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_x_, point_x.data(), point_bytes,
+                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_y_, point_y.data(), point_bytes,
+                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(device_clustered_, 0,
+                              static_cast<std::size_t>(point_count_)));
+
+        std::size_t free_bytes = 0;
+        std::size_t total_bytes = 0;
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemGetInfo(&free_bytes, &total_bytes));
+        (void)total_bytes;
+
+        const std::size_t row_bytes =
+            static_cast<std::size_t>(point_count_) * sizeof(double);
+        // Leave room for the CUDA context, MPI buffers, and concurrent ranks
+        // in case users intentionally place more than one rank on a GPU.
+        const std::size_t usable_bytes =
+            (free_bytes / 5U * 4U) /
+            static_cast<std::size_t>(std::max(1, ranks_sharing_gpu));
+        const int requested_capacity = std::max(1, maximum_seed_count);
+        const std::size_t memory_capacity =
+            std::max<std::size_t>(1, usable_bytes / row_bytes);
+        batch_capacity_ = static_cast<int>(std::min<std::size_t>(
+            static_cast<std::size_t>(requested_capacity), memory_capacity));
+
+        // Fragmented or concurrently allocated device memory can make the
+        // estimate optimistic.  Retrying smaller batches keeps memory usage
+        // bounded without changing the algorithm.
+        while (batch_capacity_ > 0) {

+                static_cast<std::size_t>(batch_capacity_) * row_bytes;
+            const cudaError_t status =
+                cudaMalloc(&device_max_distances_, workspace_bytes);
+            if (status == cudaSuccess) {

             }
+            cudaGetLastError();

+    std::pair<int, int> evaluate(const std::vector<int>& seeds,

+    std::vector<int> materialize(int seed, int expected_cardinality,
+                                 double threshold_squared) {

+                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+        growCandidatesKernel<true><<<1, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
+            device_x_, device_y_, device_clustered_, device_seeds_,
+            device_cardinalities_, device_members_, device_max_distances_,
+            point_count_, threshold_squared);

+                              cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));

+                         "MPI rank %d: regenerated seed %d with size %d, "

+            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
+        }
+
+        std::vector<int> members(static_cast<std::size_t>(cardinality));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(members.data(), device_members_,
+                              static_cast<std::size_t>(cardinality) * sizeof(int),
+                              cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        return members;
+    }
+
+    void markClustered(const std::vector<int>& members) {
+        const int member_count = static_cast<int>(members.size());
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_members_, members.data(),
+                              static_cast<std::size_t>(member_count) * sizeof(int),
+                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+        const int block_count =
+            (member_count + CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE - 1) / CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE;
+        markClusteredKernel<<<block_count, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
+            device_clustered_, device_members_, member_count);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+    }

+private:
+    int point_count_ = 0;
+    int batch_capacity_ = 0;
+    double* device_x_ = nullptr;
+    double* device_y_ = nullptr;
+    double* device_max_distances_ = nullptr;
+    unsigned char* device_clustered_ = nullptr;
+    int* device_seeds_ = nullptr;
+    int* device_cardinalities_ = nullptr;
+    int* device_members_ = nullptr;
+    std::vector<int> host_cardinalities_;

+std::vector<Cluster> qtClusteringHybrid(const std::vector<Point>& points,
+                                        double threshold,
+                                        GpuCandidateEngine& gpu,
+                                        int rank, int world_size) {
+    const int point_count = static_cast<int>(points.size());
+    const double threshold_squared = threshold * threshold;
+    std::vector<unsigned char> clustered(static_cast<std::size_t>(point_count), 0);
+    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;
+    std::vector<int> local_seeds;
+    local_seeds.reserve(
+        static_cast<std::size_t>((point_count + world_size - 1) / world_size));
+    int remaining = point_count;
+
+    while (remaining > 0) {
+        local_seeds.clear();
+        for (int seed = rank; seed < point_count; seed += world_size) {
+            if (!clustered[seed]) {
+                local_seeds.push_back(seed);
+            }
+        }
+
+        const auto [local_cardinality, local_seed] =
+            gpu.evaluate(local_seeds, threshold_squared);
+
+        struct {
+            int cardinality;
+            int seed;
+        } local_best{local_cardinality, local_seed}, global_best{-1, INT_MAX};
+
+        MPI_Allreduce(&local_best, &global_best, 1, MPI_2INT,
+                      MPI_MAXLOC, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
+        if (global_best.seed == INT_MAX || global_best.cardinality <= 0) {
+            break;
+        }
+
+        // If the largest candidate is a singleton, every remaining candidate
+        // is a singleton.  Removing points cannot make a later candidate grow,
+        // so emit the rest in the original ascending-seed order without one
+        // global synchronization per point.
+        if (global_best.cardinality == 1) {
+            if (rank == 0) {
+                for (int seed = 0; seed < point_count; ++seed) {
+                    if (!clustered[seed]) {
+                        clusters.push_back(Cluster{{seed}, seed});
+                    }
+                }
+            }
+            remaining = 0;
             break;
         }
+
+        const int owner = global_best.seed % world_size;
+        std::vector<int> best_members;
+        if (rank == owner) {
+            best_members = gpu.materialize(global_best.seed,
+                                           global_best.cardinality,
+                                           threshold_squared);
+        } else {
+            best_members.resize(
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(global_best.cardinality));
+        }
+        MPI_Bcast(best_members.data(), global_best.cardinality, MPI_INT,
+                  owner, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
+
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
+        for (int index = 0; index < global_best.cardinality; ++index) {
+            clustered[best_members[static_cast<std::size_t>(index)]] = 1;
+        }
+        gpu.markClustered(best_members);
+        remaining -= global_best.cardinality;
+
+        if (rank == 0) {
+            clusters.push_back(Cluster{std::move(best_members), global_best.seed});
+        }
     }
-    
+
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());
     return clusters;
 }

+__device__ __forceinline__ void warpReduceBest(double& distance, int& index) {

+// Grow one candidate per CUDA block.  Storing only the running maximum
+// squared distance for every point turns the original repeated O(k) diameter
+// scan into one O(N) update per added member.  Squaring is monotone for these
+// non-negative distances, so choices and the strict threshold are unchanged.
+template <bool SAVE_MEMBERS>
+__global__ void growCandidatesKernel(const double* __restrict__ point_x,
+                                     const double* __restrict__ point_y,
+                                     const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,
+                                     const int* __restrict__ seeds,
+                                     int* __restrict__ cardinalities,
+                                     int* __restrict__ saved_members,
+                                     double* __restrict__ max_distance_squared,
+                                     int point_count,
+                                     double threshold_squared) {
+    const int row = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x);
+    const int seed = seeds[row];
+    double* const distances = max_distance_squared +
+                              static_cast<std::size_t>(row) * point_count;
+
+    constexpr int warp_count = CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32;
+    __shared__ double warp_distance[warp_count];
+    __shared__ int warp_index[warp_count];
+    __shared__ int selected;
+    __shared__ int cardinality;
+
+    for (int point = threadIdx.x; point < point_count; point += blockDim.x) {
+        if (clustered[point] || point == seed) {
+            distances[point] = DBL_MAX;
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        const double dx = point_x[point] - point_x[seed];
+        const double dy = point_y[point] - point_y[seed];
+        const double distance_squared = dx * dx + dy * dy;
+        // A rejected point can never become eligible: its running maximum
+        // only increases as the candidate cluster grows.
+        distances[point] = distance_squared < threshold_squared
+                               ? distance_squared
+                               : DBL_MAX;
+    }
+
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
+        cardinality = 1;
+        if constexpr (SAVE_MEMBERS) {
+            saved_members[0] = seed;
         }
     }
-    
-    return closest_point;
-}
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    while (true) {
+        double local_distance = DBL_MAX;
+        int local_index = INT_MAX;
+
+        for (int point = threadIdx.x; point < point_count; point += blockDim.x) {
+            const double distance_squared = distances[point];
+            if (distance_squared < threshold_squared &&
+                betterCandidate(distance_squared, point,
+                                local_distance, local_index)) {
+                local_distance = distance_squared;
+                local_index = point;
+            }
+        }
+
+        warpReduceBest(local_distance, local_index);
+        const int lane = threadIdx.x & (warpSize - 1);
+        const int warp = threadIdx.x / warpSize;
+        if (lane == 0) {
+            warp_distance[warp] = local_distance;
+            warp_index[warp] = local_index;
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        if (warp == 0) {
+            local_distance = lane < warp_count ? warp_distance[lane] : DBL_MAX;
+            local_index = lane < warp_count ? warp_index[lane] : INT_MAX;
+            warpReduceBest(local_distance, local_index);
+            if (lane == 0) {
+                selected = local_index == INT_MAX ? -1 : local_index;
+                if (selected >= 0) {
+                    if constexpr (SAVE_MEMBERS) {
+                        saved_members[cardinality] = selected;
+                    }
+                    ++cardinality;
+                }
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();

+class GpuCandidateEngine {
+public:
+    GpuCandidateEngine(const std::vector<double>& point_x,
+                       const std::vector<double>& point_y,
+                       int maximum_seed_count,
+                       int ranks_sharing_gpu)
+        : point_count_(static_cast<int>(point_x.size())) {
+        const std::size_t point_bytes =
+            static_cast<std::size_t>(point_count_) * sizeof(double);
+        const std::size_t member_bytes =
+            static_cast<std::size_t>(point_count_) * sizeof(int);
+
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&device_x_, point_bytes));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&device_y_, point_bytes));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&device_clustered_,
+                              static_cast<std::size_t>(point_count_)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&device_members_, member_bytes));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_x_, point_x.data(), point_bytes,
+                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_y_, point_y.data(), point_bytes,
+                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(device_clustered_, 0,
+                              static_cast<std::size_t>(point_count_)));
+
+        std::size_t free_bytes = 0;
+        std::size_t total_bytes = 0;
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemGetInfo(&free_bytes, &total_bytes));
+        (void)total_bytes;
+
+        const std::size_t row_bytes =
+            static_cast<std::size_t>(point_count_) * sizeof(double);
+        // Leave room for the CUDA context, MPI buffers, and concurrent ranks
+        // in case users intentionally place more than one rank on a GPU.

+            static_cast<std::size_t>(requested_capacity), memory_capacity));

+        // bounded without changing the algorithm.

+            const cudaError_t status =

+                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));

+        }

+        std::vector<int> members(static_cast<std::size_t>(cardinality));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(members.data(), device_members_,
+                              static_cast<std::size_t>(cardinality) * sizeof(int),
+                              cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));

+    }
+
+    void markClustered(const std::vector<int>& members) {
+        const int member_count = static_cast<int>(members.size());
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_members_, members.data(),
+                              static_cast<std::size_t>(member_count) * sizeof(int),
+                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+        const int block_count =
+            (member_count + CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE - 1) / CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE;
+        markClusteredKernel<<<block_count, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
+            device_clustered_, device_members_, member_count);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+    }

+private:

+    int batch_capacity_ = 0;

+    double* device_y_ = nullptr;
+    double* device_max_distances_ = nullptr;
+    unsigned char* device_clustered_ = nullptr;
+    int* device_seeds_ = nullptr;
+    int* device_cardinalities_ = nullptr;
+    int* device_members_ = nullptr;

+std::vector<Cluster> qtClusteringHybrid(const std::vector<Point>& points,
+                                        double threshold,
+                                        GpuCandidateEngine& gpu,
+                                        int rank, int world_size) {
+    const int point_count = static_cast<int>(points.size());
+    const double threshold_squared = threshold * threshold;
+    std::vector<unsigned char> clustered(static_cast<std::size_t>(point_count), 0);
+    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;
+    std::vector<int> local_seeds;
+    local_seeds.reserve(
+        static_cast<std::size_t>((point_count + world_size - 1) / world_size));
+    int remaining = point_count;
+
+    while (remaining > 0) {
+        local_seeds.clear();
+        for (int seed = rank; seed < point_count; seed += world_size) {
+            if (!clustered[seed]) {
+                local_seeds.push_back(seed);
+            }
+        }
+
+        const auto [local_cardinality, local_seed] =
+            gpu.evaluate(local_seeds, threshold_squared);
+
+        struct {
+            int cardinality;
+            int seed;
+        } local_best{local_cardinality, local_seed}, global_best{-1, INT_MAX};
+
+        MPI_Allreduce(&local_best, &global_best, 1, MPI_2INT,
+                      MPI_MAXLOC, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
+        if (global_best.seed == INT_MAX || global_best.cardinality <= 0) {
+            break;
+        }
+
+        // If the largest candidate is a singleton, every remaining candidate
+        // is a singleton.  Removing points cannot make a later candidate grow,
+        // so emit the rest in the original ascending-seed order without one
+        // global synchronization per point.
+        if (global_best.cardinality == 1) {
+            if (rank == 0) {
+                for (int seed = 0; seed < point_count; ++seed) {
+                    if (!clustered[seed]) {
+                        clusters.push_back(Cluster{{seed}, seed});
+                    }
+                }
+            }
+            remaining = 0;
             break;
         }
+
+        const int owner = global_best.seed % world_size;
+        std::vector<int> best_members;
+        if (rank == owner) {
+            best_members = gpu.materialize(global_best.seed,
+                                           global_best.cardinality,
+                                           threshold_squared);
+        } else {
+            best_members.resize(
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(global_best.cardinality));
+        }
+        MPI_Bcast(best_members.data(), global_best.cardinality, MPI_INT,
+                  owner, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
+
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
+        for (int index = 0; index < global_best.cardinality; ++index) {
+            clustered[best_members[static_cast<std::size_t>(index)]] = 1;
+        }
+        gpu.markClustered(best_members);
+        remaining -= global_best.cardinality;
+
+        if (rank == 0) {
+            clusters.push_back(Cluster{std::move(best_members), global_best.seed});
+        }
     }
-    
+
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());
     return clusters;
 }

codex
One scaling issue showed up in the default runtime environment: it exposes 256 OpenMP threads, so launching a full host team merely to mark a typical 5–40-element cluster dominated the GPU time. I’m retaining OpenMP for the coarse host work while making that fine-grained loop conditional, which avoids oversubscription without weakening the MPI/CUDA decomposition.

+// Grow one candidate per CUDA block.  Storing only the running maximum
+// squared distance for every point turns the original repeated O(k) diameter
+// scan into one O(N) update per added member.  Squaring is monotone for these
+// non-negative distances, so choices and the strict threshold are unchanged.
+template <bool SAVE_MEMBERS>
+__global__ void growCandidatesKernel(const double* __restrict__ point_x,
+                                     const double* __restrict__ point_y,
+                                     const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,
+                                     const int* __restrict__ seeds,
+                                     int* __restrict__ cardinalities,

+    __shared__ int cardinality;

+    for (int point = threadIdx.x; point < point_count; point += blockDim.x) {

+            distances[point] = DBL_MAX;
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        const double dx = point_x[point] - point_x[seed];
+        const double dy = point_y[point] - point_y[seed];

+        // A rejected point can never become eligible: its running maximum
+        // only increases as the candidate cluster grows.
+        distances[point] = distance_squared < threshold_squared
+                               ? distance_squared
+                               : DBL_MAX;
+    }

+            const double distance_squared = distances[point];

+                betterCandidate(distance_squared, point,
+                                local_distance, local_index)) {
+                local_distance = distance_squared;
+                local_index = point;
+            }
+        }

+        warpReduceBest(local_distance, local_index);
+        const int lane = threadIdx.x & (warpSize - 1);
+        const int warp = threadIdx.x / warpSize;
+        if (lane == 0) {
+            warp_distance[warp] = local_distance;
+            warp_index[warp] = local_index;
+        }

+            local_index = lane < warp_count ? warp_index[lane] : INT_MAX;

+                        saved_members[cardinality] = selected;
+                    }

+class GpuCandidateEngine {
+public:
+    GpuCandidateEngine(const std::vector<double>& point_x,
+                       const std::vector<double>& point_y,
+                       int maximum_seed_count,
+                       int ranks_sharing_gpu)
+        : point_count_(static_cast<int>(point_x.size())) {
+        const std::size_t point_bytes =
+            static_cast<std::size_t>(point_count_) * sizeof(double);
+        const std::size_t member_bytes =
+            static_cast<std::size_t>(point_count_) * sizeof(int);
+
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&device_x_, point_bytes));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&device_y_, point_bytes));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&device_clustered_,
+                              static_cast<std::size_t>(point_count_)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&device_members_, member_bytes));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_x_, point_x.data(), point_bytes,
+                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_y_, point_y.data(), point_bytes,
+                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(device_clustered_, 0,
+                              static_cast<std::size_t>(point_count_)));
+
+        std::size_t free_bytes = 0;
+        std::size_t total_bytes = 0;
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemGetInfo(&free_bytes, &total_bytes));
+        (void)total_bytes;
+
+        const std::size_t row_bytes =
+            static_cast<std::size_t>(point_count_) * sizeof(double);
+        // Leave room for the CUDA context, MPI buffers, and concurrent ranks
+        // in case users intentionally place more than one rank on a GPU.
+        const std::size_t usable_bytes =
+            (free_bytes / 5U * 4U) /

+        const int requested_capacity = std::max(1, maximum_seed_count);
+        const std::size_t memory_capacity =

+            static_cast<std::size_t>(requested_capacity), memory_capacity));

+        // bounded without changing the algorithm.

+            const cudaError_t status =
+                cudaMalloc(&device_max_distances_, workspace_bytes);

+                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));

+            device_x_, device_y_, device_clustered_, device_seeds_,
+            device_cardinalities_, device_members_, device_max_distances_,
+            point_count_, threshold_squared);

+        }

+        std::vector<int> members(static_cast<std::size_t>(cardinality));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(members.data(), device_members_,
+                              static_cast<std::size_t>(cardinality) * sizeof(int),
+                              cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));

+    }
+
+    void markClustered(const std::vector<int>& members) {
+        const int member_count = static_cast<int>(members.size());
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_members_, members.data(),
+                              static_cast<std::size_t>(member_count) * sizeof(int),
+                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+        const int block_count =
+            (member_count + CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE - 1) / CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE;
+        markClusteredKernel<<<block_count, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
+            device_clustered_, device_members_, member_count);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+    }

+private:
+    int point_count_ = 0;
+    int batch_capacity_ = 0;
+    double* device_x_ = nullptr;
+    double* device_y_ = nullptr;
+    double* device_max_distances_ = nullptr;
+    unsigned char* device_clustered_ = nullptr;
+    int* device_seeds_ = nullptr;
+    int* device_cardinalities_ = nullptr;
+    int* device_members_ = nullptr;

+std::vector<Cluster> qtClusteringHybrid(const std::vector<Point>& points,
+                                        double threshold,
+                                        GpuCandidateEngine& gpu,
+                                        int rank, int world_size) {
+    const int point_count = static_cast<int>(points.size());
+    const double threshold_squared = threshold * threshold;
+    std::vector<unsigned char> clustered(static_cast<std::size_t>(point_count), 0);
+    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;
+    std::vector<int> local_seeds;
+    local_seeds.reserve(
+        static_cast<std::size_t>((point_count - 1) / world_size + 1));
+    int remaining = point_count;
+
+    while (remaining > 0) {
+        local_seeds.clear();
+        for (int seed = rank; seed < point_count; seed += world_size) {
+            if (!clustered[seed]) {
+                local_seeds.push_back(seed);
+            }
+        }
+
+        const auto [local_cardinality, local_seed] =
+            gpu.evaluate(local_seeds, threshold_squared);
+
+        struct {
+            int cardinality;
+            int seed;
+        } local_best{local_cardinality, local_seed}, global_best{-1, INT_MAX};
+
+        MPI_Allreduce(&local_best, &global_best, 1, MPI_2INT,
+                      MPI_MAXLOC, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
+        if (global_best.seed == INT_MAX || global_best.cardinality <= 0) {
+            break;
+        }
+
+        // If the largest candidate is a singleton, every remaining candidate
+        // is a singleton.  Removing points cannot make a later candidate grow,
+        // so emit the rest in the original ascending-seed order without one
+        // global synchronization per point.
+        if (global_best.cardinality == 1) {
+            if (rank == 0) {
+                for (int seed = 0; seed < point_count; ++seed) {
+                    if (!clustered[seed]) {
+                        clusters.push_back(Cluster{{seed}, seed});
+                    }
+                }
+            }
+            remaining = 0;
             break;
         }
+
+        const int owner = global_best.seed % world_size;
+        std::vector<int> best_members;
+        if (rank == owner) {
+            best_members = gpu.materialize(global_best.seed,
+                                           global_best.cardinality,
+                                           threshold_squared);
+        } else {
+            best_members.resize(
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(global_best.cardinality));
+        }
+        MPI_Bcast(best_members.data(), global_best.cardinality, MPI_INT,
+                  owner, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
+
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) if(global_best.cardinality >= 4096)
+        for (int index = 0; index < global_best.cardinality; ++index) {
+            clustered[best_members[static_cast<std::size_t>(index)]] = 1;
+        }
+        gpu.markClustered(best_members);
+        remaining -= global_best.cardinality;
+
+        if (rank == 0) {
+            clusters.push_back(Cluster{std::move(best_members), global_best.seed});
+        }
     }
-    
+
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());
     return clusters;
 }

+// non-negative distances, so choices and the strict threshold are unchanged.
+template <bool SAVE_MEMBERS>
+__global__ void growCandidatesKernel(const double* __restrict__ point_x,
+                                     const double* __restrict__ point_y,
+                                     const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,
+                                     const int* __restrict__ seeds,
+                                     int* __restrict__ cardinalities,
+                                     int* __restrict__ saved_members,
+                                     double* __restrict__ max_distance_squared,
+                                     int point_count,
+                                     double threshold_squared) {
+    const int row = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x);
+    const int seed = seeds[row];
+    double* const distances = max_distance_squared +
+                              static_cast<std::size_t>(row) * point_count;
+
+    constexpr int warp_count = CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE / 32;
+    __shared__ double warp_distance[warp_count];
+    __shared__ int warp_index[warp_count];
+    __shared__ int selected;
+    __shared__ int cardinality;
+
+    for (int point = threadIdx.x; point < point_count; point += blockDim.x) {
+        if (clustered[point] || point == seed) {
+            distances[point] = DBL_MAX;
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        const double dx = point_x[point] - point_x[seed];
+        const double dy = point_y[point] - point_y[seed];
+        const double distance_squared = dx * dx + dy * dy;
+        // A rejected point can never become eligible: its running maximum
+        // only increases as the candidate cluster grows.
+        distances[point] = distance_squared < threshold_squared
+                               ? distance_squared
+                               : DBL_MAX;
+    }
+
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
+        cardinality = 1;
+        if constexpr (SAVE_MEMBERS) {
+            saved_members[0] = seed;
         }
     }
-    
-    return closest_point;
-}
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    while (true) {
+        double local_distance = DBL_MAX;
+        int local_index = INT_MAX;
+
+        for (int point = threadIdx.x; point < point_count; point += blockDim.x) {
+            const double distance_squared = distances[point];
+            if (distance_squared < threshold_squared &&
+                betterCandidate(distance_squared, point,
+                                local_distance, local_index)) {
+                local_distance = distance_squared;
+                local_index = point;
+            }
+        }
+
+        warpReduceBest(local_distance, local_index);
+        const int lane = threadIdx.x & (warpSize - 1);
+        const int warp = threadIdx.x / warpSize;
+        if (lane == 0) {
+            warp_distance[warp] = local_distance;
+            warp_index[warp] = local_index;
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        if (warp == 0) {
+            local_distance = lane < warp_count ? warp_distance[lane] : DBL_MAX;
+            local_index = lane < warp_count ? warp_index[lane] : INT_MAX;
+            warpReduceBest(local_distance, local_index);
+            if (lane == 0) {
+                selected = local_index == INT_MAX ? -1 : local_index;
+                if (selected >= 0) {
+                    if constexpr (SAVE_MEMBERS) {
+                        saved_members[cardinality] = selected;
+                    }
+                    ++cardinality;
+                }
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();

+class GpuCandidateEngine {
+public:
+    GpuCandidateEngine(const std::vector<double>& point_x,
+                       const std::vector<double>& point_y,
+                       int maximum_seed_count,
+                       int ranks_sharing_gpu)
+        : point_count_(static_cast<int>(point_x.size())) {
+        const std::size_t point_bytes =
+            static_cast<std::size_t>(point_count_) * sizeof(double);
+        const std::size_t member_bytes =
+            static_cast<std::size_t>(point_count_) * sizeof(int);
+
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&device_x_, point_bytes));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&device_y_, point_bytes));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&device_clustered_,
+                              static_cast<std::size_t>(point_count_)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&device_members_, member_bytes));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_x_, point_x.data(), point_bytes,
+                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_y_, point_y.data(), point_bytes,
+                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(device_clustered_, 0,
+                              static_cast<std::size_t>(point_count_)));
+
+        std::size_t free_bytes = 0;
+        std::size_t total_bytes = 0;
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemGetInfo(&free_bytes, &total_bytes));
+        (void)total_bytes;
+
+        const std::size_t row_bytes =
+            static_cast<std::size_t>(point_count_) * sizeof(double);
+        // Leave room for the CUDA context, MPI buffers, and concurrent ranks
+        // in case users intentionally place more than one rank on a GPU.
+        const std::size_t usable_bytes =
+            (free_bytes / 5U * 4U) /
+            static_cast<std::size_t>(std::max(1, ranks_sharing_gpu));
+        const int requested_capacity = std::max(1, maximum_seed_count);
+        const std::size_t memory_capacity =
+            std::max<std::size_t>(1, usable_bytes / row_bytes);
+        batch_capacity_ = static_cast<int>(std::min<std::size_t>(
+            static_cast<std::size_t>(requested_capacity), memory_capacity));
+
+        // Fragmented or concurrently allocated device memory can make the
+        // estimate optimistic.  Retrying smaller batches keeps memory usage
+        // bounded without changing the algorithm.
+        while (batch_capacity_ > 0) {
+            const std::size_t workspace_bytes =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(batch_capacity_) * row_bytes;
+            const cudaError_t status =
+                cudaMalloc(&device_max_distances_, workspace_bytes);
+            if (status == cudaSuccess) {
+                break;
             }
+            cudaGetLastError();
+            batch_capacity_ /= 2;
         }
-        
-        // If we found a cluster, add it

-            cluster.seed_point = best_seed;

-            
-            // Mark all members as clustered
-            for (size_t i = 0; i < best_cluster_members.size(); ++i) {
-                clustered[best_cluster_members[i]] = true;
+        if (batch_capacity_ == 0) {
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaErrorMemoryAllocation);
+        }
+
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&device_seeds_,
+                              static_cast<std::size_t>(batch_capacity_) *
+                                  sizeof(int)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&device_cardinalities_,
+                              static_cast<std::size_t>(batch_capacity_) *
+                                  sizeof(int)));
+        host_cardinalities_.resize(batch_capacity_);
+    }
+
+    GpuCandidateEngine(const GpuCandidateEngine&) = delete;
+    GpuCandidateEngine& operator=(const GpuCandidateEngine&) = delete;
+
+    ~GpuCandidateEngine() {
+        cudaFree(device_cardinalities_);
+        cudaFree(device_seeds_);
+        cudaFree(device_max_distances_);
+        cudaFree(device_members_);
+        cudaFree(device_clustered_);
+        cudaFree(device_y_);
+        cudaFree(device_x_);
+    }
+
+    int batchCapacity() const { return batch_capacity_; }
+
+    std::pair<int, int> evaluate(const std::vector<int>& seeds,
+                                 double threshold_squared) {
+        int best_cardinality = -1;
+        int best_seed = INT_MAX;
+
+        for (std::size_t offset = 0; offset < seeds.size();
+             offset += static_cast<std::size_t>(batch_capacity_)) {
+            const int batch_size = static_cast<int>(std::min<std::size_t>(
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(batch_capacity_),
+                seeds.size() - offset));
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_seeds_, seeds.data() + offset,
+                                  static_cast<std::size_t>(batch_size) * sizeof(int),
+                                  cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+
+            growCandidatesKernel<false>
+                <<<batch_size, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
+                    device_x_, device_y_, device_clustered_, device_seeds_,
+                    device_cardinalities_, nullptr, device_max_distances_,
+                    point_count_, threshold_squared);
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(host_cardinalities_.data(),
+                                  device_cardinalities_,
+                                  static_cast<std::size_t>(batch_size) * sizeof(int),
+                                  cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+
+            for (int index = 0; index < batch_size; ++index) {
+                const int seed = seeds[offset + static_cast<std::size_t>(index)];
+                const int cardinality = host_cardinalities_[index];
+                if (cardinality > best_cardinality ||
+                    (cardinality == best_cardinality && seed < best_seed)) {

             }

-                unclustered_indices.end()
-            );
-        } else {
-            // No more clusters can be formed
+        }
+
+        return {best_cardinality, best_seed};
+    }
+
+    std::vector<int> materialize(int seed, int expected_cardinality,
+                                 double threshold_squared) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_seeds_, &seed, sizeof(int),
+                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+        growCandidatesKernel<true><<<1, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
+            device_x_, device_y_, device_clustered_, device_seeds_,
+            device_cardinalities_, device_members_, device_max_distances_,
+            point_count_, threshold_squared);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+
+        int cardinality = 0;
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(&cardinality, device_cardinalities_, sizeof(int),
+                              cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        if (cardinality != expected_cardinality) {
+            int rank = -1;
+            MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);
+            std::fprintf(stderr,
+                         "MPI rank %d: regenerated seed %d with size %d, "
+                         "expected %d\n",
+                         rank, seed, cardinality, expected_cardinality);
+            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
+        }
+
+        std::vector<int> members(static_cast<std::size_t>(cardinality));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(members.data(), device_members_,
+                              static_cast<std::size_t>(cardinality) * sizeof(int),
+                              cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        return members;
+    }
+
+    void markClustered(const std::vector<int>& members) {
+        const int member_count = static_cast<int>(members.size());
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_members_, members.data(),
+                              static_cast<std::size_t>(member_count) * sizeof(int),
+                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+        const int block_count =
+            (member_count + CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE - 1) / CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE;
+        markClusteredKernel<<<block_count, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
+            device_clustered_, device_members_, member_count);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+    }
+
+private:
+    int point_count_ = 0;
+    int batch_capacity_ = 0;
+    double* device_x_ = nullptr;
+    double* device_y_ = nullptr;
+    double* device_max_distances_ = nullptr;
+    unsigned char* device_clustered_ = nullptr;
+    int* device_seeds_ = nullptr;
+    int* device_cardinalities_ = nullptr;
+    int* device_members_ = nullptr;
+    std::vector<int> host_cardinalities_;
+};

+std::vector<Cluster> qtClusteringHybrid(const std::vector<Point>& points,
+                                        double threshold,
+                                        GpuCandidateEngine& gpu,
+                                        int rank, int world_size) {
+    const int point_count = static_cast<int>(points.size());
+    const double threshold_squared = threshold * threshold;
+    std::vector<unsigned char> clustered(static_cast<std::size_t>(point_count), 0);
+    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;
+    std::vector<int> local_seeds;
+    local_seeds.reserve(
+        static_cast<std::size_t>((point_count - 1) / world_size + 1));
+    int remaining = point_count;
+
+    while (remaining > 0) {
+        local_seeds.clear();
+        for (int seed = rank; seed < point_count; seed += world_size) {
+            if (!clustered[seed]) {
+                local_seeds.push_back(seed);
+            }
+        }
+
+        const auto [local_cardinality, local_seed] =
+            gpu.evaluate(local_seeds, threshold_squared);
+
+        struct {
+            int cardinality;
+            int seed;
+        } local_best{local_cardinality, local_seed}, global_best{-1, INT_MAX};
+
+        MPI_Allreduce(&local_best, &global_best, 1, MPI_2INT,
+                      MPI_MAXLOC, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
+        if (global_best.seed == INT_MAX || global_best.cardinality <= 0) {
+            break;
+        }
+
+        // If the largest candidate is a singleton, every remaining candidate
+        // is a singleton.  Removing points cannot make a later candidate grow,
+        // so emit the rest in the original ascending-seed order without one
+        // global synchronization per point.
+        if (global_best.cardinality == 1) {
+            if (rank == 0) {
+                for (int seed = 0; seed < point_count; ++seed) {
+                    if (!clustered[seed]) {
+                        clusters.push_back(Cluster{{seed}, seed});
+                    }
+                }
+            }
+            remaining = 0;
             break;
         }
+
+        const int owner = global_best.seed % world_size;
+        std::vector<int> best_members;
+        if (rank == owner) {
+            best_members = gpu.materialize(global_best.seed,
+                                           global_best.cardinality,
+                                           threshold_squared);
+        } else {
+            best_members.resize(
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(global_best.cardinality));
+        }
+        MPI_Bcast(best_members.data(), global_best.cardinality, MPI_INT,
+                  owner, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
+
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) if(global_best.cardinality >= 4096)
+        for (int index = 0; index < global_best.cardinality; ++index) {
+            clustered[best_members[static_cast<std::size_t>(index)]] = 1;
+        }
+        gpu.markClustered(best_members);
+        remaining -= global_best.cardinality;
+
+        if (rank == 0) {
+            clusters.push_back(Cluster{std::move(best_members), global_best.seed});
+        }
     }
-    
+
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());
     return clusters;
 }

+class GpuCandidateEngine {
+public:
+    GpuCandidateEngine(const std::vector<double>& point_x,
+                       const std::vector<double>& point_y,
+                       int maximum_seed_count,
+                       int ranks_sharing_gpu)
+        : point_count_(static_cast<int>(point_x.size())) {
+        const std::size_t point_bytes =
+            static_cast<std::size_t>(point_count_) * sizeof(double);
+        const std::size_t member_bytes =
+            static_cast<std::size_t>(point_count_) * sizeof(int);
+
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&device_x_, point_bytes));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&device_y_, point_bytes));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&device_clustered_,
+                              static_cast<std::size_t>(point_count_)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&device_members_, member_bytes));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_x_, point_x.data(), point_bytes,
+                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_y_, point_y.data(), point_bytes,
+                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(device_clustered_, 0,
+                              static_cast<std::size_t>(point_count_)));
+
+        std::size_t free_bytes = 0;
+        std::size_t total_bytes = 0;
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemGetInfo(&free_bytes, &total_bytes));
+        (void)total_bytes;
+
+        const std::size_t row_bytes =
+            static_cast<std::size_t>(point_count_) * sizeof(double);
+        // Leave room for the CUDA context, MPI buffers, and concurrent ranks
+        // in case users intentionally place more than one rank on a GPU.
+        const std::size_t usable_bytes =
+            (free_bytes / 5U * 4U) /
+            static_cast<std::size_t>(std::max(1, ranks_sharing_gpu));
+        const int requested_capacity = std::max(1, maximum_seed_count);
+        const std::size_t memory_capacity =
+            std::max<std::size_t>(1, usable_bytes / row_bytes);
+        batch_capacity_ = static_cast<int>(std::min<std::size_t>(
+            static_cast<std::size_t>(requested_capacity), memory_capacity));
+
+        // Fragmented or concurrently allocated device memory can make the
+        // estimate optimistic.  Retrying smaller batches keeps memory usage
+        // bounded without changing the algorithm.
+        while (batch_capacity_ > 0) {
+            const std::size_t workspace_bytes =
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(batch_capacity_) * row_bytes;
+            const cudaError_t status =
+                cudaMalloc(&device_max_distances_, workspace_bytes);
+            if (status == cudaSuccess) {
+                break;
             }
+            cudaGetLastError();
+            batch_capacity_ /= 2;
         }
-        
-        // If we found a cluster, add it

-            
-            // Mark all members as clustered
-            for (size_t i = 0; i < best_cluster_members.size(); ++i) {
-                clustered[best_cluster_members[i]] = true;
+        if (batch_capacity_ == 0) {
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaErrorMemoryAllocation);
+        }
+
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&device_seeds_,
+                              static_cast<std::size_t>(batch_capacity_) *
+                                  sizeof(int)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&device_cardinalities_,
+                              static_cast<std::size_t>(batch_capacity_) *
+                                  sizeof(int)));
+        host_cardinalities_.resize(batch_capacity_);
+    }
+
+    GpuCandidateEngine(const GpuCandidateEngine&) = delete;
+    GpuCandidateEngine& operator=(const GpuCandidateEngine&) = delete;
+
+    ~GpuCandidateEngine() {
+        cudaFree(device_cardinalities_);
+        cudaFree(device_seeds_);
+        cudaFree(device_max_distances_);
+        cudaFree(device_members_);
+        cudaFree(device_clustered_);
+        cudaFree(device_y_);

+
+    int batchCapacity() const { return batch_capacity_; }

+    std::pair<int, int> evaluate(const std::vector<int>& seeds,
+                                 double threshold_squared) {
+        int best_cardinality = -1;
+        int best_seed = INT_MAX;
+
+        for (std::size_t offset = 0; offset < seeds.size();
+             offset += static_cast<std::size_t>(batch_capacity_)) {
+            const int batch_size = static_cast<int>(std::min<std::size_t>(
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(batch_capacity_),
+                seeds.size() - offset));
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_seeds_, seeds.data() + offset,
+                                  static_cast<std::size_t>(batch_size) * sizeof(int),
+                                  cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+
+            growCandidatesKernel<false>
+                <<<batch_size, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
+                    device_x_, device_y_, device_clustered_, device_seeds_,
+                    device_cardinalities_, nullptr, device_max_distances_,
+                    point_count_, threshold_squared);
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(host_cardinalities_.data(),
+                                  device_cardinalities_,
+                                  static_cast<std::size_t>(batch_size) * sizeof(int),
+                                  cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+
+            for (int index = 0; index < batch_size; ++index) {
+                const int seed = seeds[offset + static_cast<std::size_t>(index)];
+                const int cardinality = host_cardinalities_[index];
+                if (cardinality > best_cardinality ||

-                unclustered_indices.end()
-            );
-        } else {
-            // No more clusters can be formed
+        }

+        return {best_cardinality, best_seed};
+    }
+
+    std::vector<int> materialize(int seed, int expected_cardinality,
+                                 double threshold_squared) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_seeds_, &seed, sizeof(int),
+                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+        growCandidatesKernel<true><<<1, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
+            device_x_, device_y_, device_clustered_, device_seeds_,
+            device_cardinalities_, device_members_, device_max_distances_,
+            point_count_, threshold_squared);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+
+        int cardinality = 0;
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(&cardinality, device_cardinalities_, sizeof(int),
+                              cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        if (cardinality != expected_cardinality) {
+            int rank = -1;
+            MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);
+            std::fprintf(stderr,
+                         "MPI rank %d: regenerated seed %d with size %d, "
+                         "expected %d\n",
+                         rank, seed, cardinality, expected_cardinality);
+            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
+        }
+
+        std::vector<int> members(static_cast<std::size_t>(cardinality));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(members.data(), device_members_,
+                              static_cast<std::size_t>(cardinality) * sizeof(int),
+                              cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        return members;
+    }
+
+    void markClustered(const std::vector<int>& members) {
+        const int member_count = static_cast<int>(members.size());
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_members_, members.data(),
+                              static_cast<std::size_t>(member_count) * sizeof(int),
+                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+        const int block_count =
+            (member_count + CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE - 1) / CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE;
+        markClusteredKernel<<<block_count, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
+            device_clustered_, device_members_, member_count);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+    }
+
+private:
+    int point_count_ = 0;
+    int batch_capacity_ = 0;
+    double* device_x_ = nullptr;
+    double* device_y_ = nullptr;
+    double* device_max_distances_ = nullptr;
+    unsigned char* device_clustered_ = nullptr;
+    int* device_seeds_ = nullptr;
+    int* device_cardinalities_ = nullptr;
+    int* device_members_ = nullptr;
+    std::vector<int> host_cardinalities_;
+};

+std::vector<Cluster> qtClusteringHybrid(const std::vector<Point>& points,
+                                        double threshold,
+                                        GpuCandidateEngine& gpu,
+                                        int rank, int world_size) {
+    const int point_count = static_cast<int>(points.size());
+    const double threshold_squared = threshold * threshold;
+    std::vector<unsigned char> clustered(static_cast<std::size_t>(point_count), 0);
+    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;
+    std::vector<int> local_seeds;
+    local_seeds.reserve(
+        static_cast<std::size_t>((point_count - 1) / world_size + 1));
+    int remaining = point_count;
+
+    while (remaining > 0) {
+        local_seeds.clear();
+        for (int seed = rank; seed < point_count; seed += world_size) {
+            if (!clustered[seed]) {
+                local_seeds.push_back(seed);
+            }
+        }
+
+        const auto [local_cardinality, local_seed] =
+            gpu.evaluate(local_seeds, threshold_squared);
+
+        struct {
+            int cardinality;
+            int seed;
+        } local_best{local_cardinality, local_seed}, global_best{-1, INT_MAX};
+
+        MPI_Allreduce(&local_best, &global_best, 1, MPI_2INT,
+                      MPI_MAXLOC, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
+        if (global_best.seed == INT_MAX || global_best.cardinality <= 0) {
+            break;
+        }
+
+        // If the largest candidate is a singleton, every remaining candidate
+        // is a singleton.  Removing points cannot make a later candidate grow,
+        // so emit the rest in the original ascending-seed order without one
+        // global synchronization per point.
+        if (global_best.cardinality == 1) {
+            if (rank == 0) {
+                for (int seed = 0; seed < point_count; ++seed) {
+                    if (!clustered[seed]) {
+                        clusters.push_back(Cluster{{seed}, seed});
+                    }
+                }
+            }
+            remaining = 0;
             break;
         }
+
+        const int owner = global_best.seed % world_size;
+        std::vector<int> best_members;
+        if (rank == owner) {
+            best_members = gpu.materialize(global_best.seed,
+                                           global_best.cardinality,
+                                           threshold_squared);
+        } else {
+            best_members.resize(
+                static_cast<std::size_t>(global_best.cardinality));
+        }
+        MPI_Bcast(best_members.data(), global_best.cardinality, MPI_INT,
+                  owner, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
+
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) if(global_best.cardinality >= 4096)
+        for (int index = 0; index < global_best.cardinality; ++index) {
+            clustered[best_members[static_cast<std::size_t>(index)]] = 1;
+        }
+        gpu.markClustered(best_members);
+        remaining -= global_best.cardinality;
+
+        if (rank == 0) {
+            clusters.push_back(Cluster{std::move(best_members), global_best.seed});
+        }
     }
-    
+
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());
     return clusters;
 }

+class GpuCandidateEngine {
+public:
+    GpuCandidateEngine(const std::vector<double>& point_x,
+                       const std::vector<double>& point_y,
+                       int maximum_seed_count,
+                       int ranks_sharing_gpu)
+        : point_count_(static_cast<int>(point_x.size())) {
+        const std::size_t point_bytes =
+            static_cast<std::size_t>(point_count_) * sizeof(double);
+        const std::size_t member_bytes =
+            static_cast<std::size_t>(point_count_) * sizeof(int);
+
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&device_x_, point_bytes));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&device_y_, point_bytes));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&device_clustered_,
+                              static_cast<std::size_t>(point_count_)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&device_members_, member_bytes));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_x_, point_x.data(), point_bytes,
+                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_y_, point_y.data(), point_bytes,
+                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(device_clustered_, 0,
+                              static_cast<std::size_t>(point_count_)));
+
+        std::size_t free_bytes = 0;
+        std::size_t total_bytes = 0;
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemGetInfo(&free_bytes, &total_bytes));
+        (void)total_bytes;
+
+        const std::size_t row_bytes =
+            static_cast<std::size_t>(point_count_) * sizeof(double);
+        // Leave room for the CUDA context, MPI buffers, and concurrent ranks
+        // in case users intentionally place more than one rank on a GPU.
+        const std::size_t usable_bytes =
+            (free_bytes / 5U * 4U) /
+            static_cast<std::size_t>(std::max(1, ranks_sharing_gpu));
+        const int requested_capacity = std::max(1, maximum_seed_count);
+        const std::size_t memory_capacity =
+            std::max<std::size_t>(1, usable_bytes / row_bytes);
+        batch_capacity_ = static_cast<int>(std::min<std::size_t>(
+            static_cast<std::size_t>(requested_capacity), memory_capacity));
+
+        // Fragmented or concurrently allocated device memory can make the
+        // estimate optimistic.  Retrying smaller batches keeps memory usage
+        // bounded without changing the algorithm.
+        while (batch_capacity_ > 0) {

+                static_cast<std::size_t>(batch_capacity_) * row_bytes;
+            const cudaError_t status =
+                cudaMalloc(&device_max_distances_, workspace_bytes);
+            if (status == cudaSuccess) {
+                break;
             }
+            cudaGetLastError();

         }

+    GpuCandidateEngine(const GpuCandidateEngine&) = delete;
+    GpuCandidateEngine& operator=(const GpuCandidateEngine&) = delete;

+    std::pair<int, int> evaluate(const std::vector<int>& seeds,
+                                 double threshold_squared) {

+                static_cast<std::size_t>(batch_capacity_),

+                                  static_cast<std::size_t>(batch_size) * sizeof(int),
+                                  cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));

+                const int cardinality = host_cardinalities_[index];

+    std::vector<int> materialize(int seed, int expected_cardinality,
+                                 double threshold_squared) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_seeds_, &seed, sizeof(int),
+                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+        growCandidatesKernel<true><<<1, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
+            device_x_, device_y_, device_clustered_, device_seeds_,
+            device_cardinalities_, device_members_, device_max_distances_,
+            point_count_, threshold_squared);

+        int cardinality = 0;
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(&cardinality, device_cardinalities_, sizeof(int),
+                              cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));

+            int rank = -1;
+            MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);
+            std::fprintf(stderr,
+                         "MPI rank %d: regenerated seed %d with size %d, "
+                         "expected %d\n",
+                         rank, seed, cardinality, expected_cardinality);
+            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
+        }
+
+        std::vector<int> members(static_cast<std::size_t>(cardinality));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(members.data(), device_members_,
+                              static_cast<std::size_t>(cardinality) * sizeof(int),
+                              cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        return members;
+    }
+
+    void markClustered(const std::vector<int>& members) {
+        const int member_count = static_cast<int>(members.size());
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_members_, members.data(),
+                              static_cast<std::size_t>(member_count) * sizeof(int),
+                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+        const int block_count =
+            (member_count + CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE - 1) / CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE;
+        markClusteredKernel<<<block_count, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
+            device_clustered_, device_members_, member_count);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+    }
+
+private:
+    int point_count_ = 0;
+    int batch_capacity_ = 0;
+    double* device_x_ = nullptr;
+    double* device_y_ = nullptr;
+    double* device_max_distances_ = nullptr;
+    unsigned char* device_clustered_ = nullptr;
+    int* device_seeds_ = nullptr;
+    int* device_cardinalities_ = nullptr;
+    int* device_members_ = nullptr;
+    std::vector<int> host_cardinalities_;
+};
